what: Evidentiary-number manifest for the Research Note 'Chaos and Bifurcations in Continuous Language-Model Feedback'. Every number in the note is quoted from the full report. Each entry gives the string as it appears in index.md (appears_as) and the phrase of the report's LaTeX source that states it (paper_text, whitespace collapsed), with its line in that source at the stated commit. The memory extension has separate exact-commit receipt fields and is verified by verify_memory_update.py; historical report bindings are retained.

generator.note: Pinned to the final report, commit 13145281 (the supplementary report that accompanies the article of the same title). On 20 October 2026 the annotated release tag arxiv-v1 of the research repository points to this commit; the note links to the repository at that tag. Round 14 rebound every entry to this commit and recomputed its paper_line.

verification: For each entry, (1) appears_as occurs in index.md after replacing en dashes, em dashes and minus signs with hyphens and removing asterisks, as scripts/check_provenance.py checks; (2) paper_text occurs in its paper_file (paper/llm/main.tex, or paper/llm/figures/fig-readout-gain.tex for three entries) at the stated commit (13145281 for this manifest; an entry with paper_commit is checked at that commit instead) after collapsing runs of whitespace to single spaces, and paper_line is the line of that file on which the phrase begins. For the memory extension run python verify_memory_update.py --verify --research-repo /path/to/neural-shrimp; this re-derives added numerical claims and verifies receipt, source and asset hashes.

batch-difference-schematic.svg.note: Hand-drawn conceptual schematic; no data, not to scale. Its description quotes the paper's 1.27 to 176% range and its 0 to 16 steps after the distance passes 1e-2.

one-picture-schematic.svg.note: Hand-drawn conceptual schematic of the paper's section 'From greedy loops to chaos: one picture'; not to scale, bar widths illustrative. Its labels quote the paper's values for that section: flip at log10 T = -0.5147881 and fold at -0.1741065 of the 2-cycle at alpha = 0.070, the band's flips at -0.1414292 and -0.1392937, windows of period 2N + 6 crowding as 1/N^2, and the period-3 fold at alpha = 0.065, log10 T = -0.14536.

saddle-basin-boundary.svg.note: Hand-drawn conceptual diagram for the paper's paragraph 'Why the lower edge lies where it does': a saddle orbit, its stable manifold separating the basins of two attracting orbits, its unstable manifold and two starts that linger before leaving to different attractors; no data, not to scale.
